age.never: The area has not been scanned yet
age.staleTitle: The latest area scan is more than 24 hours old; today's figures may have changed.

noArea.title: No market area chosen yet
noArea.body: Choose an area (a district, or a radius around your hotel) in <link>Settings › Market</link> to see how many rooms the area has left over the next 14 nights.
noArea.viewer: Ask your hotel admin to choose an area in Settings › Market.

trend.title: Area tightness, next 14 nights
trend.info: Each night comes from that night's latest Booking.com scan. Top row: share of hotels in the area that are sold out. Bottom row: hotels with at least {deep} rooms left, coloured against the usual level. Not occupancy, not a forecast.
trend.soldOutTitle: Share of hotels in the area that are sold out (a minimum)
trend.deepTitle: Hotels that can still sell at least {deep} rooms at once
trend.nightSoldOut: at least {pct}% of hotels sold out ({available, number}/{base, number} with rooms)
trend.nightAvailable: {available, plural, one {# hotel} other {# hotels}} with rooms
trend.nightDeep: {count, plural, one {# hotel} other {# hotels}} with at least {deep} rooms
trend.nightBooking: Booking.com's own figure: {pct}% of all properties in the area unavailable
trend.legendDeep: At least {deep} rooms left, vs usual:
trend.empty: None of the next 14 nights has been scanned yet. The area is scanned every day at 03:00.

today.title: Today in the area
today.info: From the scan of the area's hotel list on Booking.com. Every figure is the minimum Booking.com shows, not occupancy.
today.available: {available, number}/{base, number} hotels in the area still have rooms
today.availableNoBase: {available, number} hotels in the area still have rooms
today.deep: {count, number} have at least {rooms} rooms left
today.mood: {level, select, loose {a loose} moderate {a moderate} tight {a tight} other {a}} market{trend, select, usual {, as usual} tighter {, tighter than usual} looser {, looser than usual} other {}}
today.moodTitle: Loose: under 10% of hotels sold out. Moderate: 10–50%. Tight: 50% and above. “Usual” compares the share of hotels with at least {deep} rooms with the other nights of the scan.
today.soldOutLine: {bound, select, floor {At least } other {}}{pct}% of hotels in the area are sold out: {available, number}/{base, number} have rooms. The base is the most hotels with rooms seen in the last 30 days of scans.
today.bookingLine: {pct}% is Booking.com's own figure for the whole area, counting every property type (apartments, guesthouses…), so it differs from the figure above.
today.bookingLow: Booking.com says the area has low availability (counting every property type).
today.ladderTitle: {count, plural, one {# hotel} other {# hotels}} can still sell at least {rooms} {rooms, plural, one {room} other {rooms}} at once
today.ladderUnknown: The {rooms}-room level was not scanned for this night
today.ladderMissing: No room levels for this night yet.
today.floorTitle: Sum of the rooms each hotel can still sell (each hotel at its highest level)
today.medianTitle: Half the hotels are cheaper, half pricier ({priced, plural, one {# hotel} other {# hotels}} with a rate)
today.composition: All property types: {count, number} with rooms
today.priceBookingNote: Properties above {max} are not in the chart
today.sampleTitle: Rates from hotels seen on the results page; does not cover the whole area
today.selfRoomsPage: From the scan of your hotel's page
today.selfRoomsPercentile: more rooms left than {pct}% of hotels in the area
today.selfPricier: {price}, pricier than {pct}% of hotels in the area
today.selfCheaper: {price}, cheaper than {pct}% of hotels in the area
today.selfRankTitle: Position in Booking.com's “popularity” order for the area
today.selfNotInArea: not in the area's results tonight
today.selfNotInAreaTitle: Your hotel is not in the area's search results: it is sold out, outside the radius, or Booking.com does not place it in this area
today.fillTitle: Estimated from {coverage, plural, one {# hotel} other {# hotels}} scanned in detail with enough data (experimental, not occupancy)
today.emptyBody: The area is scanned every day at 03:00. You can also press “Scan list now” in <link>Settings › Market</link>.
today.runningBody: Figures appear when the scan finishes. Follow it in <link>Settings › Market</link>.
today.failedTitle: Tonight's figures could not be read
today.failedBody: The latest scan could not read the pages; it will retry automatically. See <link>Settings › Market</link>.

weather.title: Weather
weather.info: 5-day forecast at your hotel (OpenWeather), updated every 30 minutes.

calendar.title: Events & holidays, next 12 months
calendar.info: Public holidays for the hotel's country and local events you add in Settings › Events. % is the extra demand you expect. Click a period to see availability around those dates.
